# AyeFinance — Software Atelier

> High-performance personal finance management, multi-account ledger, and 30-day cash flow forecasting engine from the AyeApps suite.

## Product & Capabilities
- [AyeFinance](https://finance.ayeapps.com): Precision personal finance tracker and liquidity management engine. Replaces spreadsheets with real-time multi-account tracking (liquid checking, high-yield savings, investments).
- Double-entry style money transfers and categorised expense and income allocation.
- Automated cash flow projections: 30-day forecasting of available liquidity based on active recurring items.
- Single unified multiplatform codebase for Web, iOS, and Android built on React Native and Expo SDK 57.
- Atelier Cyber-Amber design system (#FE9D01 / #050505) with dark/light themes, tactile feedback, and solid neo-brutalist elevation.

## AyeApps Ecosystem
- [AyeApps Software Atelier](https://ayeapps.com): Software engineering atelier, cloud infrastructure, and bespoke digital platforms.
- [AyeVideoDownloader](https://video.ayeapps.com): High-velocity, lossless 4K HDR multimedia conversion and audio extraction engine.
- [AyeTasks](https://tasks.ayeapps.com): High-velocity hierarchical task manager, time tracker, and project execution engine.
- [AyeFinance](https://finance.ayeapps.com): High-performance personal finance management, multi-account ledger, and 30-day cash flow forecasting engine.
- [AyeAuth](https://accounts.ayeapps.com): Centralized identity, OAuth2 SSO, and cross-application permissions provider.

## Technical Architecture
- Backend: Python 3.13, FastAPI (Strict Async), Beanie ODM (MongoDB).
- Frontend: React Native + Expo SDK 57, React Native Web, Zustand, Atelier Design Tokens.
- Security: OAuth2, HS256 JWT, Automated Token Revocation, Rate Limiting, Cloudflare Turnstile.
